basics.name: Vatsal Trivedi
basics.label: Principal Engineer · AI Platforms · Enterprise Integrations
basics.summary: Principal engineer building AI products, multi-tenant platforms, and the data systems behind them. At Phamax, I lead architecture and delivery for Ariya across eight pharma and life-sciences client deployments, connecting source-backed generation, regulated content workflows, and enterprise integrations. Previously, I led engineering for Factoreal’s omnichannel marketing platform and Comviva’s MobiLytix Rewards, spanning large-scale analytics, loyalty targeting, and event-driven services. My work combines hands-on implementation, engineering standards, and team leadership from design through production. I also build open-source developer tools.

work.name: Phamax
work.description: Ariya: AI platform for pharmaceutical content, research, analytics, and engagement
work.summary: Lead engineering for Ariya across eight client deployments, owning architecture, hands-on implementation, engineering standards, and production delivery for pharma marketing and medical teams.
highlights: Restructured the platform into core API, portal, and authoring applications; established shared engineering standards and reusable staging, UAT, and production deployment workflows.
Built the AI Content Wizard and regulated content lifecycle: configuration-driven authoring, localization, multi-stage approval, compliance checks, and distribution across content types and markets.

Architected Content Compose with three LLM stages, hybrid retrieval on Azure AI Search, deterministic source-linked bibliographies, and a 14-check validator for content completeness and citation integrity.
Designed LLM orchestration across prompts, context injection, RAG, embeddings, and tool calling; integrated Veeva CRM and Salesforce Marketing Cloud into tenant-specific omnichannel workflows.
Delivered a white-label RAG assistant over 551 medical publications with controlled access, inspectable source PDFs, feedback, audit logs, and an admin console on Azure Container Apps.
Built the Speech Avatar end to end across Azure Speech, Django, and the portal, covering streaming chat, credential exchange, conversation logs, and post-call analysis.
Architected Bronze/Silver/Gold ingestion with a DBML schema registry and run tracking; resolved six production failure causes and introduced deterministic keys for repeatable UPSERTs.
Established the Data Catalog for metadata-based discovery, observability, and self-service access; built HCP and SFMC email-data APIs powering the Daily Sales Brief.
Established repeatable SonarQube assessment and applied 20 security fixes across three client release lines, strengthening encryption, JWT validation, hashing, SQL access, and application controls.
Encrypted phone numbers at rest, automated dependency security audits, and coordinated database certificate rotation across seven environments and four services.
Improved build efficiency with uv and Docker caching; delivered a JSON-to-PPTX service and administrative APIs for content metrics and event reporting.

work.name: Comviva
work.description: MobiLytix Rewards: multi-tenant loyalty and campaign platform for telecom and retail
work.summary: Technical lead for the cloud-agnostic SaaS rewrite of MobiLytix Rewards, owning full-stack architecture, targeting services, shared backend foundations, and delivery across in-house and vendor teams.
highlights: Led the cloud-agnostic, multi-tenant platform rewrite across TypeScript, React, FeathersJS, PostgreSQL, Delta Lake, and vector databases, connecting customer-facing features to distributed service and data foundations.
Owned Kafka campaign processing with asynchronous execution and caching for high-throughput reward and loyalty workflows; delivered AI/ML personalization and segmentation capabilities.

Designed a JSON-to-PostgreSQL segmentation engine with 26 operators, including 11 date operators; supported custom member attributes without schema changes, scheduled execution, and explicit run history.
Made club provisioning transactional to prevent partial tenant setup and connected segment changes to Kafka-driven recomputation.

Authored PostgreSQL and Redis clients used by five services and service-to-service JWT helpers; centralized enrollment, membership validation, attribute updates, and caching in a shared member package.
Introduced platform observability and monitoring to support more reliable deployments and faster incident diagnosis; coordinated production releases and security remediation across six services.
Established Jest suites and coverage gates for segmentation, scheduling, and tiers, including 48 segmentation tests; strengthened shared-package delivery with TypeScript and automated publishing.

work.name: Factoreal
work.description: Factoreal: omnichannel marketing automation platform, incubated by Comviva
work.summary: Led engineering across email, SMS, WhatsApp, push, social, customer journeys, commerce, and analytics for ecommerce, sports, and other customer verticals.
highlights: Built and evolved the BigQuery analytics foundation for a platform handling 10 billion transactions; automated provisioning and scoring across 71 customer datasets and 998 scheduled queries.
Designed the Fan Maturity Model for the sports vertical, combining six channel scores and customer-configurable weights into four audience tiers, with daily scoring orchestration and portal controls.

Rebuilt the Shopify app for its App Store relaunch, covering installation, signup, store provisioning, and OAuth; expanded webhook coverage from 17 to 40 topics and added GraphQL billing subscriptions.
Built SeatGeek ticketing synchronization and WhatsApp commerce data capture; maintained Shopify API compatibility and resolved duplicate identities with country-aware phone normalization.
Centralized contact operations across five services and plan entitlements across twelve; automated customer retirement and refined contact queries and data-cleanup routines.

Strengthened account security with tenant-configurable session expiry and risk-scored signup protection; connected operational reporting through GoodData cache invalidation, social dashboards, and Jira-to-BigQuery synchronization.

work.name: Factoreal
work.description: Factoreal: omnichannel marketing automation platform, incubated by Comviva
work.summary: Built the data, integration, and channel foundations of Factoreal across its core API, React portal, and backend services, connecting customer activity to analytics and automated campaigns.
highlights: Built PostgreSQL and Cassandra-to-BigQuery synchronization across 24 entity workflows, with incremental processing and pagination; automated customer dataset provisioning at signup.
Built email delivery and engagement KPI APIs and embedded GoodData dashboards, giving customers visibility into deliverability, audience response, and unsubscribe rates.

Made Shopify order ingestion safe under webhook retries with application idempotency and database uniqueness constraints; built Redis- and Kafka-driven abandoned-cart triggers with tenant-configurable timeouts.
Integrated Razorpay payment events into Kafka and built web-push subscriptions and mobile SDK registration and events, extending commerce and engagement workflows.
Improved tracking accuracy with page deduplication, tenant-specific event exclusions, and first-visit corrections; delivered verified-domain trial onboarding and HubSpot contact migration.

Built Microsoft 365 workflows across SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, and Power BI to support collaboration, process automation, and reporting.
Implemented GA360, Google Tag Manager, and Data Studio analytics, giving life-sciences teams visibility into digital activity and performance.

projects.name: openpreflight
projects.description: Self-hosted GitHub Check Runs for private pull requests. One Go binary, one SQLite file, on a server you run. Apache-2.0.
highlights: GitHub App, webhooks, runner, UI, and local state in one deployable unit. Docker Compose or a Linux release binary.
The project checks itself: docs, site, and the binary each get a Check Run from ci.openpreflight.xyz. GitHub Actions is only used to publish release images.
Wrote a five-part series on vatsal.xyz, from the trigger model through running untrusted code.
